en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a covered market square with an obelisk-like fountain in the center. Around it is a colonnaded structure forming a rectangular courtyard. Behind the market rise steep‑gabled medieval buildings and church-like towers in Gothic style. The printed caption at the top reads "BRUGES. — Marché-aux-Poissons." and a small serial number appears at the bottom right.
